affectedModules.role: Presents Custom Vazhipadu selector chip and reveals administrator input fields (custom puja name, custom rate ₹). Calculates line total as rate * qty. Manages UI validation and reset.

Generates cryptographic financial fingerprint including custom puja name, custom unit rate, qty, and total. Executes atomic Firestore transaction creating billing record, linked receipt, reservation, and idempotency doc.
Monotonically allocates unified sequential numbering for bill (BILL-xxx) and accounting receipt (R-xxx) sharing single sequence counter and reservation doc.
Renders and prints thermal receipt with actual custom puja name, quantity, unit rate, and total. Generic 'Custom Vazhipadu' label is never printed on the bill.
Displays billing records in Active and Voided tables. Search haystack includes custom puja name. Details modal and reprint show actual custom name and unit rate.
Aggregates billing records by item description. Custom Vazhipadu items appear with their actual name in the Item Summary Table and export to CSV with item name and unit price.
Accounting engines calculate balances and income exclusively from receipts collection. Billing collection is never queried for balances, guaranteeing exactly-once financial accounting.
Displays linked accounting receipt with General Temple Fund, Vazhipadu Income, and custom description. Direct editing is blocked to maintain billing-accounting consistency.
Atomically voids billing document, linked accounting receipt, and reservation document across Firestore and IndexedDB while retaining cancellation audit reason.
Aggregates active bills by item name in Pooja Analytics and active receipts by devotee name in Devotee Analytics.
Serializes and deserializes all billing and receipt fields without filtering. Validates monetary values and preserves custom fields and cross-references across backup cycles.

riskClassifications.component: Quick-select master list array vs Existing Test 33.34A
riskClassifications.description: test_step_33_34a_vazhipadu_button.js asserts vazhipaduItems.length === 13. If Custom Vazhipadu is added statically to BILLING_DEFAULT_ITEMS, that assertion fails. If added dynamically in loadCategoryItems(), the assertion passes.
riskClassifications.mitigation: Recommend dynamic selector injection in loadCategoryItems or planned coordination with test 33.34A.

riskClassifications.description: If user submits without typing a custom puja name, the generic string 'Custom Vazhipadu' could be persisted on the sacred devotee receipt.
riskClassifications.mitigation: Mandate strict validation rejecting the literal string 'Custom Vazhipadu' or blank text, requiring an authentic administrator-entered offering name.

riskClassifications.description: computeBillingFingerprint hashes item, unitPrice, qty, and total. If custom name or rate is not trimmed or formatted, hash might mismatch on retry.
riskClassifications.mitigation: Ensure custom name is trimmed and custom unitPrice is passed as a formatted number in billingInput.

riskClassifications.component: Thermal print line overflow on 58mm paper
riskClassifications.description: Custom vazhipadu names in Malayalam can be arbitrarily long, potentially wrapping awkwardly or corrupting 58mm thermal layout.
riskClassifications.mitigation: Enforce maximum 60-character length limit on custom name input and ensure .th-row CSS supports proper word breaking.

riskClassifications.description: Risk of billing and receipt both being counted in cash book or dashboard.
riskClassifications.mitigation: Verified: Existing architecture exclusively queries activeReceipts() for accounting balances. Billing collection is never queried for financial balances.
